539-1491-4565-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

225-1018-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-1018-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-1018-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1895-3641-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-3641-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-2079-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1368-6321-6723-6791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6723-6791.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5220-6772-6826-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
5220-6772-6826-6900.description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Masked Meower from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability.
Cast Masked Meower from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

618-4456-6595-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7322.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3817-3967-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1253-1369-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Gyre Engineer's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Gyre Engineer's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Gyre Engineer's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2999-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2999-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3054-3416-5670-6794.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-6794.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6709-6768.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-5078-6709-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

104-2034-2086.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

2707-4183-5733-6504.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2707-4183-5733-6504.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Notorious Throng onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Notorious Throng from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

511-817-4050-4365-5902.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2757-3705-4050-5465.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Mountain.
2757-3705-4050-5465.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Squee, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

586-2713-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
586-2713-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-678-2060-2606-4017.description:
Cast Pelakka Wurm by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to gain 7 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting seven +1/+1 counters on itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Pelakka Wurm.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1283-2619-4483.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once.
1283-2619-4483.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {5}, targeting Rod of Absorption.
Echo Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the first copy of Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Put the tapped Chromatic Orrery into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the remaining Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining copy, if applicable.
Resolve the original Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Rod of Absorption and exiling Echo Storm due to Rod of Absorption.
Activate the original Rod of Absorption by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to cast Echo Storm from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the Rod of Absorption token.
Repeat from step 3.
If you have cast your commander from the command zone two or more times this game, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards and/or target any other artifact you control using Echo Storm.

337-4222-4508-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
337-4222-4508-4875.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

703-4772-5257.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Riku of Two Reflections' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Riku of Two Reflections' second ability trigger, causing you to pay {G}{U} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Doubling Season tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

2034-3079-3615-4999.notablePrerequisites: You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2034-3079-3615-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Humility removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

2946-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {1}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage
with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-2210-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Mirrormade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
